title: PrivBench: A Holistic and Modular Benchmarking Platform for Evaluating Text-to-Text Privatization
abstract: arXiv:2608.29624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Natural Language Processing methods have enabled novel solutions and advances in the field of privacy, particularly in the sub-domain of text-to-text privatization, where the goal is to transform a sensitive input text into a privatized output by ideally masking (in)directly identifiable or otherwise private information. The evaluation of text-to-text privatization, however, is not straightforward, and the extant literature has utilized a myriad of techniques and metrics to quantify the privacy-preserving capabilities of privatization methods. Seeking to unify the evaluation of text-to-text privatization, we introduce PrivBench, a holistic and modular benchmarking platform for researchers and practitioners working on text privatization. PrivBench is holistic in that it evaluates privatization on a series of defined desiderata, which are structured into modules. PrivBench is not only modular but also extensible, allowing for future update

translated_title: PrivBench：一个用于评估文本到文本隐私化的整体式模块化基准测试平台
translated_abstract: 自然语言处理方法为隐私领域带来了新颖的解决方案和进展，特别是在文本到文本隐私化这一子领域中，其目标是将敏感的输入文本转换为隐私化的输出，理想情况下通过掩蔽直接或间接可识别的信息及其他隐私信息来实现。然而，文本到文本隐私化的评估并非易事，现有文献已采用多种技术和指标来量化隐私化方法的隐私保护能力。为了统一文本到文本隐私化的评估，我们推出了PrivBench，这是一个面向从事文本隐私化研究的研究者和从业者的整体式模块化基准测试平台。PrivBench的整体性体现在它基于一系列定义好的评估标准来评估隐私化，这些标准被组织成模块。PrivBench不仅模块化，而且可扩展，支持未来的更新。
tldr: 本文提出了PrivBench，一个整体式且可扩展的模块化基准测试平台，通过一系列定义好的评估标准模块来统一评估文本到文本隐私化方法的隐私保护能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PrivBench, a holistic and modular benchmarking platform that unifies the evaluation of text-to-text privatization methods through a series of defined desiderata structured into extensible modules.
